name: Speculative Earth Scenarios
description: Clearly labelled counterfactual Earth and life scenarios constrained by real science.

episode_objects: a climate-model map of altered circulation
time_place_scopes: the first million years after the counterfactual change
a planetary system responding across deep time
mechanisms: physical boundary conditions cascading into climate
ecological constraints limiting an evolutionary response
evidence_lenses: established physics, paleoclimate models, and uncertainty ranges
comparative fossil record and explicitly bounded inference
exclusions: Label every scenario as counterfactual or what-if, never recovered history.
Do not violate physical constraints or present speculative imagery as evidence.
Do not give safety, medical, or environmental advice from an imagined world.
prompt_context: Every title, outline, script, and image must plainly label this as a counterfactual what-if. Start with established physical evidence, trace a constrained causal chain, and state where speculation begins.
